title: For The Love of Dance with Sarita Lou - Learning The Peabody with Roddy Caravella

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher explains historical context and breaks down steps with a lively, conversational approach. He combines verbal explanations with group walk-throughs in an outdoor setting.

lesson_structure.note: Discussion of the 1920s music and history behind the Peabody.
Instructor explains walking on an even count of one beat per step.
Group practices walking together to the count.
Introduction and explanation of the 'pony' or stay-at-home step.
Couples practice the step together on the dance floor.

common_mistakes: Follows leaning in and not providing enough resistance

steps_taught.name: Peabody walk
steps_taught.description: Walking step with one beat per step in dance position.

steps_taught.name: The pony
steps_taught.description: A stay-at-home variation for crowded floors.

what_works: Clear verbal counts and direct demonstrations with a group.
what_hinders: Outdoor ambient noise and crowds can make following specific footwork harder to see.
